services.name: Bumper Boat Rental
services.desc: Accessible to the open lake surroundings, these boats are just great for floating around or getting immersed in water fights. Each bumper boat seats one person and is powered by a 24-volt (environmentally friendly) motor, that has a water gun capable of squirting your opponent up to 10 feet away. Ages 5+ can operate their own boat. Must be supervised by an adult. Boats can seat 1 adult per boat or 1 adult and child 7 or under. Digital waivers MUST be submitted prior to arrival. blurb: Guests can enjoy a giant inflatable water park with various obstacles and activities for 1.5 hours. They offer waterpark access, bumper boat rides, wetsuit rentals, and premium Sea-Doo rentals on Harrison Lake. Activities cater to all ages with certified lifeguards and safety training provided.
